members.bio:
Dr.Ashok Mondal is a Postdoctoral researcher at the Institute of Low-Dimensional Quantum Materials, Hubei University of Technology, China. His research focuses on Strong light-matter interaction in van der Waals (vdW) materials, Bose-Einstein condensation, Cavity Quantum Electrodynamics, and 2D device physics.
He received his PhD degree from the Center for Integrated Nanostructure Physics, Institute for Basic Science (IBS), Sungkyunkwan University (SKKU) under the guidance of Prof. Young Hee Lee. His work has been published in journals including Nature Nanotechnology, Nature Review Physics, Science Advances, Advanced Materials, ACS Nano, and Springer Nature.
